finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.assumptions: The function get_error_message might return user-controlled or attacker-controlled data, and printf does not sanitize the input before using it.

parsed.change_summary: Added a missing closing quote in the printf statement.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding no longer works because the printf statement now correctly formats the string, preventing any potential OS command injection. The missing quote ensures that the error message is treated as a string literal, and any malicious input within the error message is not executed as a command.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked whether printf is a command execution sink; confirmed that printf only outputs formatted text and does not invoke the shell or execute commands. Reviewed the code for any other potential command execution paths and found none. No checks or sanitization are required for printf in this context. The reported trigger "error_message contains malicious input" cannot lead to OS command execution.
